text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Wondering why I'm reading in a place
like this?
Your face betrays you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever heard that the law should
serve
the people, as opposed to the
other way around?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's a reminder that knowing your
constituents is
vital to governing, but
one must also know the
law to teach it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I am studying the law while
also
observing the people. Killing two
birds with one
stone, if you will. You
should try it sometime.
